title: The AI context gap: Enterprise AI organizations have a trust problem, not a retrieval problem — and most are still building the fix
brief: A VentureBeat survey of 101 enterprises finds that 57% have experienced AI agents producing confident but incorrect answers due to missing or inconsistent business context, despite RAG becoming the standard retrieval method. The research reveals a "context gap" where enterprises deploy retrieval-augmented generation faster than they can validate its reliability, with provider-native solutions like OpenAI's file search (40%) and Google's Vertex AI Search (38%) already outpacing dedicated vector databases.
